description_en: Queries the snapshots and their details for a cloud desktop

kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-snapshots --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --desktop-name testName --snapshot-id s-2ze81owrnv9pity40000 --snapshot-name Test_data_disk --source-disk-type system --snapshot-type user --os-type Windows --creator Administrator --start-time 2020-11-30T06:32:31Z --end-time 2020-11-31T06:32:31Z --next-token 8051af8d01b5479bec9f5ddf02e4a8fbd0ab6e7e43f80000 --max-results 10 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSnapshots

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region. Call [](t2167755.xdita#)to get a list of regions that support Elastic Desktop Service (EDS).

parameters.description_en: The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 127 characters long. It must start with a letter. It can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with `auto` to avoid naming conflicts with automatic snapshots.
parameters.description_zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2\~127个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头。可以包含数字、下划线（\_）或者短划线（-）。为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以`auto`开头。
